description: Put both parts on the chest and refused to paste a quarrel.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Heard. The hooks were not this argument.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Refused to recopy until the book was one book.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Brought the Latin ending and kept the size separate from the cue.
name: John Heminges

description: Heard. His voice was not the fault.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Found the size on the boards before the morning let him go.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Showed the half-mended copy and the three misses.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Saw the chest and the two endings, and not a face.
name: William Shakespeare
